blocks.content: Scripts are `.py` files in the notebook. They run on the server with a `squire` library that can read and edit your notes.
The button above runs a script that creates a note and adds to it. Click any script link to read the code and run it from there (Ctrl+Enter also runs it).

- [[Hello Notebook.py]]: lists the notes in the notebook
- [[squire_example.py]]: every function in the library, from reading notes to creating, moving and deleting them; the calls that change the notebook are written as comments
